anti_js.note: No JavaScript or node tooling used in this experiment.

data_sources.pit_status: Uses Form 4 usable_trade_date and only OHLCV rows before the usable trade date inside fixed snapshots; no filing or price lookahead added.

decision_rationale: The post-drawdown Form 4 slice was positive versus the core baseline, but failed replacement value against raw Form 4 or failed one of the window, sample, drawdown, or concentration guards.

sample_officer_titles: EVP, CSO & Pres. LRL & LLY Imm
EVP, CSO & Pres. LRL & LLY Imm

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry / candidate_pool: insider purchases are more informative after a material drawdown, when the filing may signal ownership conviction into forced or exhausted selling rather than generic insider interest.

2_history_check.exp-20260504-034: Raw Form 4 event satellite was positive but not promoted.
2_history_check.exp-20260530-011: Multi-filer Form 4 owner-count qualifier did not create promotable evidence.
2_history_check.exp-20260531-002: Purchase-value-to-prior-ADV floor did not beat raw queue cleanly.
2_history_check.exp-20260602-016: Form4 + FINRA short-pressure consensus did not improve raw Form4 queue.
2_history_check.exp-20260602-031: Pre-event RS20 underpriced qualifier was positive vs core but failed raw replacement value.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: Only the event qualifier changes by adding prior 60-trading-day drawdown from high <= -20%; core strategy, Form4 threshold, event notional, capacity, hold period, LLM/news, ranking, sizing, and exits stay fixed.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; must improve aggregate EV/PnL versus core and raw Form4, avoid window EV/PnL regressions, and pass drawdown, survival, target sample, and concentration guards.

hypothesis: PIT-safe Form 4 meaningful purchase events may have better forward value when the usable trade date arrives after the ticker has already fallen at least 20% from its prior 60-trading-day high.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: This run uses deterministic free SEC Form 4 rows plus fixed OHLCV snapshots; LLM soft-ranking remains sample-blocked.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

prediction.confidence_reason: Form 4 is PIT-safe and free, but prior Form 4 qualifiers often failed raw-queue replacement value; post-drawdown is a distinct ownership-conviction timing field.

production_impact.promotion_blocker_if_positive: A shared default-off Form 4 post-drawdown paper adapter must be wired through production and replay with source-row caching and parity tests before any production report or order behavior can change.

single_causal_variable: raw PIT-safe Form 4 forward events require prior close <= 80% of prior 60-trading-day high before the usable trade date
why_not_other_alpha: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay attribution remains sparse. Skipped Companyfacts, post-earnings high-liquidity/scalar retunes, peer earnings transfer, VBB, VCP, state-surface, and FINRA threshold retunes per playbook freeze guidance. Options/13F were skipped because current coverage is not PIT-safe and dense across the three windows.
